name: aura-desktop
description: Aura Messenger desktop client for Windows
author: Aura

scripts.dev: cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= AURA_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:3001 AURA_APP_PATH=/app.html AURA_ELECTRON_DEV=1 electron .
scripts.build:win: npm run assets:icon && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis portable
scripts.publish:win: npm run assets:icon && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis portable --publish always
